entities.name: Spiro ketal substrate
observations: Tokenized substrate decodes approximately to Fc1c(N2CCC3(CC2)OCCO3)ccc2cccnc12; contains a piperidine spiro 1,3-dioxolane ketal.

entities.name: N-aryl piperidin-4-one
observations: Product is the corresponding N-aryl piperidin-4-one, approximately O=C1CCN(C2=CC=C3C=CC=NC3=C2F)CC1.

entities.name: Ketal hydrolysis finding
observations: Transformation hydrolyzes the spiro ethylene ketal to a piperidin-4-one without forming a new C-C or C-N bond.
Closest empirical ORD record reports 80.8% yield after 18 h in THF and lists chloride and sodium hydroxide; exact acid catalyst and temperature are not established.
Plausible reagents are aqueous HCl or dilute H2SO4 in aqueous THF, followed as needed by basification; aqueous p-TsOH is another reasonable acid catalyst.
